metadata.title: CHARLES GERHARDT SA VIE, SON ŒUVRE, SA CORRESPONDANCE 1816-1856

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The text features clear serifs (small strokes at the ends of the letters) and a moderate contrast between thick and thin strokes. The proportions and structure are characteristic of classical book faces used in academic and formal publishing during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
